thread:
Maya (PM): short sync — planning launch criteria for the Observability heatmap & error-fingerprint features. want to confirm minimal scope for pilot.
Priya (SRE): main risk is trace ingestion. prefer heatmap based on aggregated spans, not full traces.
Arjun (Eng): agree. minimal scope: heatmap (route x model token cost), error fingerprints (top stack signatures), p50/p95 latencies. keep traces linked but sampled.
Carlos (Data Eng): to support per-route cost heatmap we need a route_id tag. overhead ~2% throughput. support configurable retention (14d pilot).
Maya (PM): pilot customers: Atlas & Nimbus. Atlas specifically asked for cost heatmap and daily reconciliation.
Sam (Product Ops): acceptance checklist idea: 1) heatmap visible in UI; 2) daily cost estimate column; 3) ability to filter by model & route; 4) short walkthrough delivered.
Arjun (Eng): sampling policy proposal:
```yaml
sampling:
  default: 0.02
  errors: 1.0
  top_routes: 0.5
  max_write_concurrency: 32
  flush_ms: 2500
```
Priya (SRE): rollout gates: error rate delta <= 12%, p95 latency delta <= 35ms, est per-request cost <= +10%. auto-fail to previous stable variant on breach.
Carlos (Data Eng): reconciliation plan: estimate mode (hourly) + reconcile mode (daily full join). precision target: within 15% for pilot.
Maya (PM): timeline: we want an internal pilot in 4 weeks. propose 3 sprints: sprint1 = tagging + agg pipelines; sprint2 = UI heatmap + alerting; sprint3 = canary + docs + walkthroughs.
Sam (Product Ops): will schedule Nimbus walkthrough for pilot week. need screenshots and one-pager.
Arjun (Eng): infra note: put heatmap aggregator as a low-priority worker to avoid tail spikes; backpressure if queue > 200k.
Priya (SRE): also need FD limit test and fallback behavior for tracing writes. keep sampling writes bounded.
Maya (PM): acceptance criteria for pilot:
- heatmap shows per-route cost estimate and latency p50/p95
- error fingerprints show top 10 signatures and links to sampled traces
- 14d retention for metrics, sampled traces retained per config
- walkthrough completed with pilot customer and acceptance recorded
- ops runbook and rollback tested
Arjun (Eng): ACTIONS:
- add route_id tag and sampling config PR (due Wed)
- aggregator worker + backpressure PR (due Fri)

- cost-join schema + reconciliation job (due Thu)
